description: This Java source file defines a final exception class 'PolicyIdNotModifiableException' used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an error condition when policy IDs of a thing cannot be modified due to insufficient permissions. The class includes static factory methods, a builder pattern for constructing instances, and integrates with the Ditto runtime exception hierarchy.

classes.name: PolicyIdNotModifiableException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that the Policy ID of a Thing could not be modified due to insufficient permissions ('WRITE' permission is required). It extends DittoRuntimeException and implements ThingException. Includes static factory methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a nested Builder class for constructing instances.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyIdNotModifiableException from a simple message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyIdNotModifiableException from a JsonObject and headers, extracting the message.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
